rationale: FAMILY CONTRACT: cyclomatic complexity = 1 + decisions; decisions = if + for-in + ternary + && = 4, so f must be exactly 5. The old calculator counted only 'if' on this shape: its && / || cases matched NODE TYPES that do not exist (operators live inside binary_expression), for-in loops are enhanced_for_statement not for_statement, and ternary_expression was absent - measured complexity was 2. File-level metadata.complexity was the synthetic fake symbols.length + relationships.length.
